title: FirstService Residential Expands Its New Jersey Footprint, Welcoming Executive House in Hackensack, NJ
body_markdown:
# FirstService Residential Expands Its New Jersey Footprint, Welcoming Executive House in Hackensack, NJ


Thursday November 19, 2026


FirstService Residential, North America’s leading residential community management company, is proud to announce that it has been selected to provide full-service property management for Executive House, a distinguished high-rise community in Hackensack, New Jersey.


Executive House offers the best of both worlds: the comfort of a park-like, suburban setting with convenient access to shopping, dining, and public transportation. Residents enjoy an impressive lineup of amenities, including 24/7 doorman and concierge services, a salt-water pool, a clubhouse, and a parking garage.


“We are thrilled to expand our presence in Hackensack and to welcome Executive House to the FirstService Residential family,” said Michael Mendillo, President, East Region, FirstService Residential. “We are fully committed to bringing the board’s vision for the building to life.”
After a thoughtful selection process, the association’s board chose FirstService Residential for its proven success partnering with boards on strategic planning for established high-rise buildings.


“The board conducted a thoughtful search for a management company that would serve as a true partner to the community,” said Arthur Bartikofsky, Senior Vice President, High-Rise, FirstService Residential. “We look forward to working side by side with the board to achieve its long-term goals and to help ensure a bright future for this beloved high-rise.”


FirstService Residential partners with boards and residents to enhance property values, enrich community living, and deliver customized solutions tailored to each community’s unique needs. Through local expertise, innovative resources, and an unwavering commitment to service excellence, the company helps communities realize their vision and create lasting value for years to come.


**About FirstService Residential**
FirstService Residential is simplifying property management. Its hospitality-minded teams serve residential communities across the United States and Canada. The organization partners with boards, owners, and developers to enhance the value of every property and the life of every resident.


Leveraging unique expertise and scale, FirstService serves its clients with proven solutions and a service-first philosophy. Residents can count on 24/7 customer care and tailored lifestyle programming, amenity activation, and technology for their community’s specific needs. Market-leading programs with FirstService Financial, FirstService Energy, and special districts teams deliver additional levels of support.


Boards and developers select FirstService Residential to realize their vision and drive positive change for residents in the communities in their trusted care.


FirstService Residential is a subsidiary of FirstService Corporation (NASDAQ and TSX: FSV), a North American leader in providing essential property services to a wide range of residential and commercial clients.


Nov 19, 2026
